name: Jevgeni Ossinovski
detail: Dec 2023: next tax package should hit property and limited-liability companies; the article does not use the terms wealth tax or asset tax.

name: Peet Kask
detail: 2024 ERR op-ed argues for higher income taxes on the wealthy (progressive income tax); no wealth tax named.

name: Margus Tsahkna
detail: 2019: "varamaks" meant taxing cars, flats and houses, "an idea that needs public debate", not an election promise of Eesti 200.

name: Kristina Kallas (Eesti 200)
detail: 2023: wants a debate on property taxes; no net-wealth tax.

name: Enterprise asset tax (ettevõtete varamaks) debate 2024-26
detail: A tax on company assets floated by the employers and discussed by SDE and Eesti 200; a corporate tax, not a tax on personal net wealth.

name: Züleyxa Izmailova
detail: SDE MP, ERR op-ed 2024-09-19: welcomes entrepreneurs who "do not see taxing the richest assets as a bogeyman" but states no position of her own on a wealth tax.

name: Peet Kask (2025 op-ed)
detail: 2025-07-17 ERR op-ed cites the IMF and the EU on wealth taxes but notes net-wealth taxes were abandoned and urges progressive taxation of income; no wealth tax recommended.

name: Riina Sikkut
detail: 2023-03-10: "the wealthy will almost certainly have to pay more" via lower taxes on the poor; the SDE proposal is a progressive income tax.

name: Lauri Läänemets (income-tax proposals)
detail: 2022-11-19 SDE congress speech: a three- or four-band progressive income tax; recorded as income tax, not used for his grade C row.
